name: Restorative Stone
body:
Aura faint conjuration; CL 5th; Slot none; Price 18,000 gp; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

A restorative stone is a piece of smooth river rock, any sharp edges long worn away by years of water and sand erosion. When placed upon a creature’s skin, the stone removes 2 points of temporary ability damage (either of the same ability or two different abilities). Only one restorative stone can be placed on a creature at any one time. The stone can be used three times per day.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item, healing stones, greater; Cost 9,000 gp.
